content: The CanTSyn shall only accept a SYNC message with Type equal to 0x10 or 0x20 if CanTSyn RxCrcValidated is configured to CRC_IGNORED .
The CanTSyn shall only accept a SYNC message with Type equal to 0x10 or 0x20 if CanTSyn RxCrcValidated is configured to CRC_IGNORED .
The CanTSyn shall only accept a SYNC message with Type equal to 0x10 or 0x20 if CanTSynRxCrcValidated is configured to CRC_- IGNORED .
